rules.name: sma50-trend
rules.note: last close above its own SMA(50) -> trend candidate

rules.name: burst-20pct
rules.note: last close >= 1.2 x close 60 bars ago -> burst candidate

rules.name: volume-confirm
rules.note: last volume > 1.5 x mean of the previous 20

rules.name: range-expansion
rules.note: (high-low) of the last bar > 5% of its close

limitations: Verdicts come from five built-in rules, not from the upstream skills' own code; the differential shows the shape of the failure, not a claim about one specific skill.
absClose is not modelled (upstream uses adjClose in places); a missing adjClose is therefore invisible here.
Only omitted fields are injected. Provider-side renames, 402/403 plan gating and stale-but-present values are out of scope.
Rules stop at 'candidate' / 'no candidate'; sizing, stops and ordering downstream of the rule are not simulated.
